title: LoreFountain Workspace Configuration
description: Project-owned configuration for the LoreFountain VS Code extension. Lives at the workspace root as lorefountain.config.json.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference, for editors/tools that resolve it independently of VS Code's own schema association.

folders.description: Workspace-relative folder names. Any field left unset uses its documented default.

world.description: Folder containing entity .md files (characters, locations, factions, objects, concepts, arcs), plus the glossary/, timeline/, and notes/ subfolders.

imports.description: Drop-zone folder for existing source docs/bibles to migrate via the 'Migrate Existing Lore' command.

assets.description: Folder for production assets and their manifests (e.g. assets/manifests/audio.json, mapping SFX/MUSIC/AMB cue tags to the licensed/generated files that fulfill them). A peer of world/, not a subfolder of it.

hiddenCategories.description: World-tree category ids to hide from the sidebar (e.g. a project with no Factions or Arcs can hide those sections without deleting anything).

export.description: Script export choices, saved by the Export Script dialog after each export. A missing or invalid field uses its default.

preset.description: The preset used last: Pure Fountain, Production draft, Audio draft or your Custom choice.

paper.description: Paper size for PDF and Word exports.

titlePage.description: Start PDF and Word exports with the script's title page.

custom.description: Your Custom preset: what an export includes.

shots.description: SHOT:, POSE:, LIGHT: and DURATION: lines.

comic.description: PAGE:, PANEL:, LAYOUT: and CAPTION: lines.

tags.description: [tags] after a convention keyword (dropping a tag keeps its line).

loreFountainTitleKeys.description: The Order: and Production Code: title-page keys.

sceneNumbers.description: Scene numbers as written, numbered automatically, or none.
